antiScalarization: No weighted maturity score. A candidate can have strong evidence and still remain Knowledge because its detail would bloat Core; a Grade-B candidate can already be Core if independent owner failures plus existing architecture show the responsibility.
coreAdmission: Materially different cross-owner support or equivalent strong independent validation.
Implementation-independent statement that regenerates multiple design choices rather than describing one treatment.
Explicit owner/transport boundary; promotion cannot steal current truth, evidence sufficiency or action authority.
Deletion consequence or repeated wrong-action class if omitted.
No narrower existing Core statement already carries the same responsibility; if it does, prefer CORE_EXISTING/REFINE over a new foundation.
deleteRule: Delete/contract shared representation when it is a failed control, duplicate of thinner Core/Knowledge, or would imply unearned machinery/authority. Historical evidence remains.

destinations.CORE_EXISTING: The candidate is already materially represented in Core; retain/possibly tighten wording rather than duplicate it.
destinations.CORE_REFINE: Cross-owner evidence earns one minimal clarification/refinement to existing Core; no new mechanism/schema/service follows.
destinations.DELETE_CONTRACT: The proposed shared form is falsified, redundant, over-granular, or unearned; preserve historical evidence in Git while removing/avoiding active shared representation.
destinations.KNOWLEDGE: Reusable cross-owner explanation with stable support and boundary, but too contextual/detailed/non-generative for smallest Core.
destinations.OWNER_LOCAL: Meaning remains product/domain-specific; keep exact owner evidence/contract and do not promote the local mechanism.
destinations.RESEARCH: Plausible/useful but support, independence, external validity, mechanism, or treatment generality remains unresolved.

knowledgeAdmission: Reusable beyond one owner/treatment and supported enough to guide reasoning.
Benefits from explanation/examples/negative-transfer boundaries that would bloat Core.
Can remain non-authoritative and revisionable without a new production seam.
mission: Assign every frozen candidate to the smallest justified destination without scalarizing heterogeneous evidence or equating recurrence with authority.
ownerLocalRule: OFR3 owner cases stay owner-local unless only their implementation-independent intersection is independently supported elsewhere.
panelRole: External model panel is advisory challenge evidence only. Final disposition is determined against this frozen contract and current owner/Core/Knowledge state.
researchReasons: Grade C/provisional resemblance, treatment/model/corpus specificity, unresolved independence, or future consumer needed.
Useful negative result whose correct active form is a research constraint rather than reusable doctrine.
